div.div:
Notes
*1 The file system is Single-AZ
The second subnet exists because AWS Managed Microsoft AD needs two
AZs. The file system, both clients and the Lambda function sit in the
first subnet
*2 The network origin of the S3 Access Points is the VPC
Lambda inside the VPC reaches it through the S3 gateway endpoint. The
artifacts bucket goes through the same endpoint
*3 Passwords are resolved from Secrets Manager secrets
Read when AWS Managed Microsoft AD and the ONTAP fsxadmin account are
created; both clients also fetch it at run time. Operations ran
through AWS Systems Manager Run Command
